human_name: HLA-DRB1 class-II locus (highly polymorphic, copy-number-variable paralog cluster)

GRCh38.note: HLA-DRB1 gene body on PGF reference haplotype; lies in the DR-region copy-number-variable haplotype block (DR1/DR8/DR51/DR52/DR53)

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: DR-region structurally varies between haplotypes — pangenome carries multiple DRB-gene arrangements

copy_count_typical: 1 (DRB1 per haplotype); DR-region carries 1-4 functional DRB paralogs (DRB1 + DRB3/4/5) depending on haplotype
architecture_note: Unlike HLA-A/B/C (always single-copy class-I), the DR-region has structural copy-number variation across haplotypes: DR1/DR10 haplotypes carry DRB1 alone; DR51 haplotypes have DRB1+DRB5; DR52 haplotypes DRB1+DRB3; DR53 haplotypes DRB1+DRB4. This is a genuine paralog CNV embedded within the broader complex_mosaic of MHC class-II. DRB2/DRB6/DRB7/DRB8/DRB9 are pseudogenes that compound the mapping problem.

exon_2.note: DRB1 exon 2 is THE hyperpolymorphic region — DRB1 alleles are typed primarily by exon 2 PSVs. See IPD-IMGT/HLA (CC-BY-ND) for allele-specific sequences. Standard clinical typing targets exon 2 amplicon.

exon_3.note: Far less polymorphic than exon 2; useful as anchor.

diagnostic_features.snp_density_note: DRB1 has >4000 distinct alleles (IPD-IMGT/HLA Release 3.55+, 2024). Most class-II disease associations (RA → DRB1*04, T1D → DRB1*03/04, narcolepsy → DRB1*15:01, MS → DRB1*15:01) map to exon 2 PSVs.

ipd_imgt_reference.use: Resolve allele-specific PSVs via API at runtime

diagnostic_features.paralog_crossmap_note: Reads from DRB1 exon 2 cross-map to DRB3/4/5 functional paralogs AND to DRB2/6/7/8/9 pseudogenes. Pseudogene cross-mapping is the worst confounder for short-read HLA-DRB1 calling.

gene_conversion_evidence.note: Inter-allelic gene conversion at DRB1 (and DRB1↔DRB3/4/5 inter-paralog conversion) is documented (Erlich 2012; Bettencourt 2008).

primary.note: Mirrors class-I strategy but require_unique_chain=false is critical because DRB1 reads have legitimate paralog hits to DRB3/4/5. Pseudogene (DRB2/6/7/8/9) hits should be detected via stage-3 multi_position and filtered.

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.rationale: DRB-paralog group: report all hits, let caller distinguish DRB1 vs DRB3/4/5 vs pseudogenes

fallback_chain.name: llm_checkpoint
fallback_chain.rationale: novel DRB allele evaluation against IPD-IMGT/HLA

primary_sources.note: Norman PJ et al., Genome Res — 95 MHC haplotypes
Horton R et al., Immunogenetics — MHC Haplotype Project, 8 DR haplotypes characterised
Robinson J et al., maintainers; CC-BY-ND, external reference only
